description: Classic LHaloTree binary format produced by the Gadget-2/Subfind pipeline and used by the original Millennium Simulation. Each file contains a compact binary header followed by a flat array of fixed-size 104-byte halo structs. Pointers are already tree-local integer indices; no reconstruction is needed. Field names are renamed to the canonical SAGE LHaloTree schema names used by both output formats (lhalo_hdf5 and lhalo_binary).
references: Springel et al. 2005, Nature 435, 629 — Millennium Simulation (https://doi.org/10.1038/nature03597)
Croton et al. 2016, ApJS 222, 22 — SAGE model (https://doi.org/10.3847/0067-0049/222/2/22)

Descendant.notes: Tree-local integer index of this halo's descendant at the next snapshot. -1 if root (no descendant).

FirstProgenitor.notes: Tree-local index of the most massive progenitor. -1 if leaf.

NextProgenitor.notes: Tree-local index of the next progenitor sharing the same descendant. -1 if none.

FirstHaloInFOFGroup.notes: Tree-local index of the central (most massive) halo in the same FOF group. A central halo points to itself.

NextHaloInFOFGroup.notes: Tree-local index of the next satellite in the same FOF group. -1 for the last satellite.

SubhaloLen.notes: Number of simulation particles bound to the halo.

Group_M_Crit200.notes: Mass within r_200 (critical). Rename only — units already correct.

Group_M_Mean200.notes: Mass within r_200 (mean). Rename only — units already correct.

Group_M_TopHat200.notes: Top-hat virial mass. Rename only — units already correct.

SubhaloPos.notes: Comoving position vector [X, Y, Z]. Shape (N, 3). On-disk values in kpc/h for both output formats: the HDF5 reader multiplies by 0.001 post-read; binary_writer divides by 1000 before packing.

SubhaloVel.notes: Peculiar velocity vector [Vx, Vy, Vz]. Shape (N, 3). Rename only.

SubhaloVMax.notes: Maximum circular velocity max(sqrt(GM/r)). Rename only.

SubhaloSpin.notes: Specific angular momentum vector [Jx, Jy, Jz]. Shape (N, 3). On-disk values in (kpc/h)(km/s) for both output formats: the HDF5 reader multiplies by 0.001 post-read; binary_writer divides by 1000 before packing. NOT the dimensionless spin parameter lambda.

SubhaloIDMostBound.notes: Particle ID of the most bound particle. int64.

SnapNum.notes: Zero-based snapshot index [0, 63] for the mini-Millennium (64 snapshots).

FileNr.notes: Source file number (0–7 for mini-Millennium). Carried through unchanged.

dropped_fields.SubhaloIndex: Not part of the SAGE LHaloTree schema. Discarded during conversion.
dropped_fields.SubHalfMass: Not part of the SAGE LHaloTree schema. Discarded during conversion.

pointer_logic.description: All five pointer fields are already stored as tree-local integer indices into the flat halo array of the same tree. Sentinel value -1 indicates no link. This matches the SAGE LHaloTree pointer convention for both output formats, so no pointer reconstruction is required. Temporal constraint: progenitor SnapNum < descendant SnapNum. Spatial constraint: FirstHaloInFOFGroup and NextHaloInFOFGroup share the same SnapNum as the halo they point to.
pointer_logic.FirstProgenitor: Already a tree-local index. Copy directly.
pointer_logic.NextProgenitor: Already a tree-local index. Copy directly.
pointer_logic.Descendant: Already a tree-local index. Copy directly.
pointer_logic.FirstHaloInFOFGroup: Already a tree-local index. Central halo satisfies FirstHaloInFOFGroup[i] == i.
pointer_logic.NextHaloInFOFGroup: Already a tree-local index. Copy directly.

known_caveats: SubhaloIndex and SubHalfMass are present in the binary struct but are not part of the SAGE LHaloTree HDF5 schema and are discarded during conversion.

ParticleMass is not stored in the LHaloTree binary. When particle_mass_msun_per_h is not supplied via --sim-config, the driver estimates it from a group mass (M_Crit200 - the field SAGE reads for central virial masses - else M_TopHat/M_Mean200) divided by Len over the most massive FOF centrals and emits a warning; the estimate is approximate because the binary carries no per-subhalo mass, so pass --sim-config for the exact value. The mini-Millennium reference value is 0.0860 x 10^10 Msun/h (Springel et al. 2005).
The binary files must be named trees_<snap>.<N> (e.g. trees_063.0). The driver discovers all such files in a directory and sorts them by file-extension number.
Multiple input binary files are merged into a single output file (HDF5 or binary depending on --output-format) with a global tree index. SAGE reads this as NumberOfOutputFiles=1.
